articles.title: Former Xbox studios Double Fine and Compulsion will keep games after going indie
articles.summary: Microsoft is spinning off four of its Xbox game studios - Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs - as part of the restructuring announced today. articles.title: Microsoft is selling off four Xbox studios as part of significant gaming cuts
articles.summary: Microsoft is laying off 4,800 employees today, and more than 30 percent of the job losses are in the company's Xbox division. The significant gaming cuts will affect nearly every part of Xbox and also involve four game studios being spun off to be run independently from Microsoft.
